epics.name: Day prioritization in calendar view
epics.vision: Currently, the daily log, has every story available to be chosen from. It isn't linked with the sprint and can't see what's been prioritized for this sprint. I want to be able to plan my days in the calendar and track my days in the daily log. In the calendar, i should be able to click on a current day, independent of clicking on a location, and bring up a planning sidebar for that day, where I am able to see all the stories prioritized in the sprint, and add stories to the day to work on. Here i should be able to adjust my day type for only that day, and enter an actual capacity if it differs from the default for the day type. These are the stories that should show up as prioritized in the daily log, with the capacity allocation pulling my availability from the day type that's already identified in the calendar. The daily log should also show me how many days left in the sprint when i open the current day,

stories.name: time estimation for stories
stories.description:
Block estimates in story creation is kind of useless because it'll always be using 0.5 as my minimum for the block counts. Its more relevant to track actual time worked rather than trying to compare it to an arbitrary estimate. The ideal implementation is where the system automatically calculates the amount of days where a story is planned. 

the functionality can be to "add a story to the current day" this takes place either in the day panel (may be cramped) or in the story itself. Where in the sprint view, there could be button to the left of the story name that says add to current day. this means that the day panel can be read only, where edits to the information contained in the day panel can trigger an open to that components panel sprint name to the sprint panel, location name to the location panel, story name(s) to the story panel etc. 

There's space that can be recaptured at the left of the story name.
